Pseudoxanthoma elasticum: Lumbar lordosis, laxity in large joints, tibia vara, high-arched palate, and dental misalignment
Elastic fibres around the vessels in the affected areas: fragmented and markedly decreased
Verhoeff-vanGieson stained sections: marked decrease or total absence of elastic fibres in both superficial and mid-dermis
Lesions: whitish papules and depressed areas with central protrusion
Location of lesions: dorsum of fingers, forearms, distal portion of thighs, and calves
loss of elastic fibers in the dermis
fragmented elastic fibers around blood vessels
Acrodermatitis chronica atrophicans: loss of hair and sebaceous glands
